library.description: Runtime-neutral storage contract: key-value store, codec, capability, context, key-domain and contract-level error types.

blocks.text: English
为功能模块和存储实现提供共同接口、键域与校验边界，让业务按能力使用存储，并在文本中保留 Map/Set。实际读写由后端负责。

items: 切换后端就要改业务代码，根因是功能模块依赖具体实现，没有共同接口。
权限中的 Map/Set 从 JSON 读回后变成普通对象，根因是原生 JSON 不表达集合类型。
等待异步写入时键悄悄变化，根因是操作仍引用调用方的数组、日期或缓冲区。
各层读出不同的超时或冲突策略，根因是重复访问可变化的选项 getter。
日志只剩一句失败消息，根因是边界重建错误时丢了来源、码值和原始 cause。
文本往返后仍是集合。 普通 JSON 会丢掉 Map/Set；内置 codec 在两端使用同一版本元组并还原嵌套类型。运行证明。
键的可变组件不再与调用方共享。 浅拷贝数组仍共享 Date 和缓冲区；键快照递归复制并复验这些组件。运行证明。
能力分支基于接纳时的完整描述。 只检查真假可能接纳错误字段，继续引用原对象又会让判断漂移；能力快照校验字段，只给旧版缺失的两个标志补 false，并返回独立记录。运行证明。
同一次操作只有一份选项记录。 重读 getter 可能改变意图；上下文快照各字段只读一次、冻结并可复用，同时把取消执行留给后端。运行证明。
错误可以追到同一个原始对象。 只拼消息会丢失诊断链；契约错误保存稳定 source/code 和精确 cause。运行证明。

blocks.text: 把嵌套权限集合编码为文本，再恢复真实的集合实例：

blocks.code:
import { collectionsJsonCodec } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const settings = { roles: new Map([['Ada', new Set(['read', 'write'])]]) }
const raw = await collectionsJsonCodec.encode(settings)
const restored = (await collectionsJsonCodec.decode(raw)) as typeof settings
console.log('输出形式:', collectionsJsonCodec.output)
console.log('Map:', restored.roles instanceof Map)
console.log('Set:', restored.roles.get('Ada') instanceof Set)
console.log('权限:', [...(restored.roles.get('Ada') ?? [])].join(', '))

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
输出形式: text
Map: true
Set: true
权限: read, write

blocks.text: 遇到异步操作中键被修改，看键快照；遇到各层重读选项，看上下文快照。
同一份权限数据直接用原生 JSON 处理会出现以下问题。此例只展示隐患，不运行：

blocks.code:
const settings = { roles: new Map([['Ada', new Set(['read', 'write'])]]) }
const raw = JSON.stringify(settings) // 隐患：Map 的条目变成空对象，嵌套 Set 也无法保留。
const restored = JSON.parse(raw) as typeof settings // 隐患：类型断言不会恢复运行时集合。
console.log(restored.roles.get('Ada')) // 隐患：roles 是普通对象，调用 get 会抛错。

blocks.text: 上一节的 codec 负责版本标记与集合还原，不需要调用方分别维护替换器和还原器。它仍受 JSON 数据模型限制，不支持循环，也不负责把文本保存到任何后端。

rows: 功能模块只需要字符串读写

blocks.text: “契约”是实现方与调用方共同遵守的输入、输出和错误规则；“能力”描述当前对象实际提供的操作；“收窄”是在运行时检查后使用更具体的接口；“快照”是捕获当前值，是否复制或冻结由具体 API 决定；“codec”是值与存储表示之间的编解码器。

rows: 在调用方修改前捕获复合键

只读取一次操作选项，把取消执行留给后端
从文本恢复嵌套的 Map 与 Set
选择通道前规范化旧版能力描述
报告契约错误时保留原始失败

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/storage-contract

blocks.text: 在工作区中使用时可以指定 `@migaia/storage-contract@workspace:^`。运行时依赖 `@migaia/utils`；需要实际后端时选择实现该契约的包。

rows: 定义功能与实现之间的 L0/L1 边界
调用记录方法前确认完整能力
将 JSON 兼容数据中的 Map/Set 编成文本并还原
在异步工作前校验并复制键
接纳能力描述，报告可追溯的契约失败

blocks.text: 本包只有根入口 `@migaia/storage-contract`，没有子路径导出。它提供存储接口、能力描述、键域、操作上下文、编解码器接口、事务作用域和契约错误，也提供校验与快照函数、集合 JSON 编解码器。运行时依赖 `@migaia/utils`；结构化取消信号类型 `IAbortSignal` 来自 `@migaia/utils/promise`。
这里没有持久化后端，不打开数据库、不写磁盘，不依赖 DOM、IndexedDB 或 Node。真正的连接、读写、提交、隔离与重试属于实现包，例如 `@migaia/storage-web`。功能模块依赖接口；实现包依赖这份契约，契约不反向依赖实现。压缩、加密或 Worker 重编码可以实现同一个 codec 接口接入，但本包不实现这些扩展。
L0 指所有后端提供的字符串键值通道；L1 指额外提供字节、结构化记录、迭代与事务的通道。能力描述说“能做什么”，不是按后端名字猜测。收窄函数检查描述符和可调用方法，不执行后端读写。
`IBackendKind` 只允许 `'local'`、`'session'`、`'cookie'`、`'indexeddb'`、`'memory'`。`IKeyValueStore` 的只读 `backend`、`capabilities` 描述后端与能力。下表的 key 均为字符串；异步方法的 ctx 默认 `undefined`，字段见操作上下文。

rows: null>`；不存在返回 null，不是 undefined。
value 为字符串，ctx 使用 IWriteOptions，返回 `Promise<void>`。
只清字符串值通道，返回 `Promise<void>`。

可选 ISyncKeyValueStore；仅同步后端提供，异步后端为 undefined。

blocks.text: `ISyncKeyValueStore` 有 `get(key): string | null`、`set(key, value, options?): void`、`remove(key): void`、`has(key): boolean`、`keys(): string[]`、`clearValues(): void`。同步 set 的唯一选项为 conflictPolicy，不接受有效 signal 或 timeoutMs。local、session、memory、cookie 等同步后端可暴露 sync；IndexedDB 等异步后端不提供它。`ISyncCapableStore<TStore>` 把某个 store 变体的可选 sync 字段收紧为必有，供实现方工厂标注返回类型，不创建同步实现。
`IRecordStore<TValue>` 保留完整 L0，增加下列成员。TValue 默认 unknown；记录主键使用 IStorageKey，字节与元数据仍用字符串键。

rows: value 为 Uint8Array，ctx 为 IWriteOptions，返回 `Promise<void>`。
只删除字节通道里的这个键，文本和记录通道不受影响；键不存在时直接成功，所以重复删除是幂等的。L1 必需方法。
`Promise<IStorageKey>`；省略 key 由后端生成并返回，ctx 为 IWriteOptions。
同时清 values、bytes、records 三个业务通道。
后端自有的可选维护通道；get(key, ctx?) 返回 unknown 或 undefined，set(key, value, ctx?) 与 delete(key, ctx?) 返回 `Promise<void>`。set 使用 IWriteOptions。
返回异步迭代器，每项为 [IStorageKey, TValue]。
run 接收 `ITransactionScope<TValue>` 并返回 `Promise<T>`；事务方法返回相同类型的 `Promise<T>`。

blocks.text: 准入一次读取相关属性，Detailed 保留精确的反射或 getter 失败原因。轻量谓词和快照返回失败结果；as 断言抛 StorageContractError，并把原始访问器错误保留在标准 cause。`asRecordStore` 的 backend 是探测到的合法后端名，探测失败为 undefined。说明快照不冻结原 store，也不证明后端方法的实现结果；已经拿到说明的组合方应复用它，避免再次触发同一 getter。

`IStorageCapabilities` 的九个字段均只读。snapshotStorageCapabilities(value) 接收 unknown，只读取一次并返回新说明对象；不是原引用，也不保证 Object.freeze。字段访问失败或类型非法返回 undefined，不抛错。`isStorageCapabilities(value)` 等价于该快照函数成功与否的布尔判断，不会把规范化字段写回原对象。

sections.id: 操作上下文-写选项与快照
sections.heading: 操作上下文、写选项与快照

blocks.text: `IOperationContext` 是异步方法末尾的可选参数；`IWriteOptions` 额外允许 conflictPolicy。

rows: undefined。结构兼容 IAbortSignal：aborted 为 boolean，addEventListener/removeEventListener 为函数。保留原信号引用。
undefined；提供时为非负安全整数，允许 0。实现层负责超时计时和与外部信号组合，本包只校验。
undefined；提供时必须为 1 到 4096 的整数，用于实现层的分页迭代。
快照未提供时仍为 undefined；写入契约的缺省策略为 conflict。合法值是 'conflict'、'replace' 或 undefined。

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy.conflict` 的值为 `'conflict'`，表示已存在则失败；`ConflictPolicy.replace` 的值为 `'replace'`，表示覆盖。使用该常量和 IConflictPolicy，不另造重复常量或别名。

`snapshotOperationContext(ctx)` 接受上下文或 undefined。undefined 原样返回；合法对象的 signal、timeoutMs、pageSize、conflictPolicy 各读一次，返回冻结快照。再次传入本函数产物会返回同一个对象，不重复读取原 getter。非法对象、字段、信号结构或 getter 失败抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，原始原因通过 cause 保留。`assertOperationContext(ctx)` 调用相同校验，只丢弃返回值。
冻结的是上下文字段，不是信号状态。已经 aborted 的有效信号也能通过形状校验；本包不等待操作、不启动计时器、不创建取消引擎。取消感知后端用 ABORTED 结束等待，不保证原生 AbortError；已经进入原子提交的写应报告真实提交结果，不伪报回滚。

`ISyncWriteOptions` 只允许可选 conflictPolicy。`snapshotSyncWriteOptions(options)` 接受对象或 undefined，读取 signal、timeoutMs、conflictPolicy，拒绝非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs；显式的 undefined 字段合法。额外 pageSize 不读取，也不提供同步分页。返回新对象 { conflictPolicy }，不冻结，省略策略仍为 undefined；`assertSyncWriteOptions(options)` 只校验、不返回快照。非法结构、字段或 getter 失败均为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。
`IStorageKey` 为 string、有限 number、有效 Date、ArrayBuffer，或这些值的非空嵌套只读数组。数组不能有空洞或循环。

rows: value 为 unknown，backend 为调用方选用的 IBackendKind，只用于错误详情；label 默认 'key'，用于错误文字。非法键抛 INVALID_KEY，并记录原键。
同样参数；先校验，再复制 Date、ArrayBuffer 和嵌套数组，最后复验。字符串和数字原样返回；结果与可变原输入分离，但不冻结。
L0、字节、元数据通道只接受字符串。label 默认 'key'；非字符串为 INVALID_ARGUMENT，不是 INVALID_KEY。
接受两个有效 IStorageKey，返回负数、零或正数，可直接交给 sort；不承诺只返回 -1/0/1。
4096，包含遍历中的数组和叶节点。
1,048,576 字节，每个二进制键组件的上限。

blocks.text: 日期不能是 NaN，数字必须有限。日期和二进制在可用时通过 structuredClone 支持跨 realm 识别；没有该能力时日期使用本地 Date 识别。二进制品牌来自 utils/bytes；constructor.name 不能伪装有效键。复制或复验失败包装为 INVALID_KEY，已是 StorageContractError 的失败直接透传。
排序依次为 number < Date < string < ArrayBuffer < 数组。同类型数字按差值，日期按时间戳，字符串按字典顺序；二进制逐字节比较、相同前缀时短者优先；数组逐段递归比较、相同前缀时短者优先。
`IKeyRange` 有可选 lower、upper（IStorageKey）和 lowerOpen、upperOpen（boolean），表达下界、上界以及是否排除对应边界，语义对应 IDBKeyRange，但不依赖它。字段省略时本包不补默认值，交给实现解释。

sections.heading: 编解码契约与集合 JSON

blocks.text: `ICodec<T, TRaw>` 的 T 默认 unknown，TRaw 声明默认值为 string | Uint8Array | unknown（等效 unknown）。它有必填 name、output、encode、decode；encode(value, ctx?) 返回 `Promise<TRaw>`，decode(raw, ctx?) 返回 `Promise<T>`。ctx 默认 undefined，使用操作上下文。`ICodecOutput` 的三个值为 text（文本）、binary（二进制）、structured（结构化值）。调用方按输出形态和后端能力选路；本包不把不支持的形态隐式转成其他形态。

`snapshotCodec(codec)` 接受 unknown；要求非 null、非数组的对象，也接纳满足结构的 class 实例。name 必须是 trim 后非空字符串，output 是三种值之一，encode/decode 必须可调用。四个属性各读取一次，返回新的浅说明对象 { name, output, encode, decode }；函数引用不变，不绑定旧 receiver，也不冻结。`assertCodec(codec)` 使用相同校验并将输入类型收窄，不返回说明对象。非法形状或读取失败为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

`collectionsJsonCodec` 是内置、冻结的 codec，name 固定为 `COLLECTIONS_JSON_CODEC_NAME`，即 `'migaia-collections-json-v1'`，output 为 text。Map 和 Set 编为带版本名、map/set kind 与数组 payload 的三元 tuple；解码只解释完全匹配的保留形式。普通或仅相似数组不猜成集合；精确匹配该保留形式的数组会被解释为集合，因此不要把这组 tuple 当普通业务数组使用。
集合之外仍遵循 JSON 表达能力，不是任意对象图的无损序列化。无法表示的根值、循环、BigInt 等 JSON 编码失败，非字符串输入、坏 JSON 或坏保留集合内容，都以 INVALID_ARGUMENT 保留原始 cause。浏览器 structured/binary codec 属于 storage-web；压缩、加密等自定义 codec 实现同一接口接入，不在本包提供。

sections.id: 事务作用域与冲突策略
sections.heading: 事务作用域与冲突策略

blocks.text: `ITransactionScope<TValue>` 只有 get(key): `Promise<TValue | undefined>`、put(value, key?, options?): `Promise<IStorageKey>`、delete(key): `Promise<void>`。key 为 IStorageKey；put 省略 key 时由实现生成。`ITransactionWriteOptions` 只有可选 conflictPolicy。
隔离级别、提交时机、失败重试由实现定义。本包不执行事务。run 回调 resolve 之后不要继续保存并使用 scope，连接或快照可能已经释放。`assertTransactionCallback(run, backend)` 在实现方分配资源前检查 run 是函数；否则抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，附 backend。
`readTransactionConflictPolicy(options, backend)` 接受 undefined 或对象；省略 options 或 conflictPolicy 返回 conflict，replace 返回 replace。直接传策略字符串、非法对象或非法字段都会抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，getter 失败保留精确 cause。它只读取策略，不执行写入。

sections.id: 变更通知与二级索引扩展
sections.heading: 变更通知与二级索引扩展

blocks.text: `IChangeFeedStore` 扩展 L0，提供 subscribeChanges(listener): unsubscribe。listener 接收提交后的 IStorageChange，取消函数由调用方持有并执行。change 的 sequence 是递增序号，origin 是来源；channel 取 value、bytes、record、all，kind 取 put、remove、clear、batch、migrate；scope 与 keys 可省略，keys 为 IStorageKey 数组。这里声明通知形状，不创建通道或跨窗口载体。
`isChangeFeedStore(candidate)` 要求完整 L0、changeFeed 为 true、subscribeChanges 可调用；`asChangeFeedStore(store)` 返回相同对象的能力视图。能力不完整为 UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY；方法或能力 getter 失败的原值保留在 cause。
`ISecondaryIndexRecordStore<TValue>` 保留完整 L1，增加以下五个方法：

rows: scope 是调用方命名的索引作用域，definitions 是定义数组，返回 IRecordIndexHandle。
handle 来自 ensureRecordIndexes，返回状态及 scanned/indexed 数量。
使用明确主键、对应句柄和投影写入，ctx 为 IWriteOptions，返回主键。
按 query 返回 [主键, TValue] 的异步迭代器。
run 接收 ISecondaryIndexTransactionScope，返回与回调一致的 Promise 结果。

blocks.text: 定义的必填字段是 name、unique、multiEntry、revision；句柄的必填字段是 scope、generation、fingerprint。readiness.status 为 pending、running、complete、failed，另有 scanned、indexed 数量。句柄绑定具体 generation，不要仅按索引名字绕过它。

query 必填 handle、index，可选 range、direction（next/prev）、limit；可选字段未提供时保持未设置，具体查询默认由实现决定。projection 按索引名映射到 undefined、{ kind: 'single', key } 或 { kind: 'multiple', keys }。索引事务 scope 有 get(key)、put(value, key, projection)、delete(key)，与普通事务 put 的可选 key/冲突选项形状不同。

`isSecondaryIndexRecordStore(candidate)` 与 `asSecondaryIndexRecordStore(store)` 同时要求完整 L1、secondaryIndexes 为 true、五个扩展方法可调用；不调用方法。断言失败为 UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY，反射或 getter 原错在 cause。扩展断言不额外承诺可用 backend 详情，失败时 backend 为 undefined。

`new StorageContractError(code, details?, message?)` 创建错误后立即冻结。code 必填；details 默认 {}，字段 backend、key、cause 都可选，默认 undefined。backend 为 IBackendKind，key 为字符串或 IStorageKey，cause 是原始失败。message 省略时为 `[storage-contract] ${code}`。name 为 StorageContractError，source 恒为 `STORAGE_CONTRACT_SOURCE`，即 `'@migaia/storage-contract'`，不重写 stack，标准 cause 仍可追到原对象。
`isStorageContractError(value)` 使用本包类的 instanceof 判断。错误码属于公开 API；实现包自己的错误 source 与这里不同，使用 (source, code) 判断归属。web codec、迁移和扩展的附加诊断细节属于 storage-web，不扩进本包错误详情。

rows: 描述符、上下文、同步写或事务选项等非法；修正参数，不重试相同坏输入。
键类型、深度、节点、字节限制、循环、空数组或空洞非法；修正键。
所需能力不存在；先做能力分支或换实现，不静默降级。
已结束的实例继续使用；新建 store。
实现层操作被信号或超时取消；按取消处理，原子提交返回真实结果。

blocks.text: 字节 guard 从 `@migaia/utils/bytes` 导入，不再从本包转出。内部槽品牌识别与字节是否仍可读是两件事，detached 对象仍可能保持品牌。`intrinsicConstructorName(value)` 只做尽力诊断：会观察可修改的原型、constructor 和 name，非对象、null 或读取失败返回 undefined。不能把它用于安全、类型或协议判断。
功能模块可以只接受 IKeyValueStore，在真正需要记录能力时按以下顺序接入：

1. 用 snapshotOperationContext(ctx) 校验并保留本次上下文。 2. 用 `asRecordStore<IProfile>`(store) 收窄；不足时直接使用既有的 UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY，不另造裸 Error。 3. 在 records.transaction 的回调里使用 tx.get/put/delete，将上下文快照传给 transaction。 4. 返回回调结果；连接、原子提交与失败重试由实际后端负责。
只支持文本的后端需要调用方明确选文本 codec 或转换方式；不能仅看到 binary 标志就跳过完整记录能力准入。自定义 gzip、加密或 Worker codec 先用 assertCodec/snapshotCodec 校验，再交给实现层使用。

sections.id: 在调用方修改前捕获复合键
sections.heading: 在调用方修改前捕获复合键

blocks.text: 异步操作仍引用调用方的数组、日期和缓冲区，原对象变化可能改变后续使用的键。只浅拷贝数组仍会共享两个嵌套对象。`snapshotStorageKey()` 校验并递归复制键组件，再次校验副本；结果与原键分离，但没有冻结。
`value` 是调用方提供的未知键；本例为字符串、Date、ArrayBuffer 组成的数组。`backend: memory` 只标记错误归属，不创建内存存储；可选 label 默认 `key`。返回键会深拷贝这些可变组件，但不冻结。

blocks.code:
import { snapshotStorageKey } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const date = new Date(0)
const bytes = new Uint8Array([7, 8])
const original: [string, Date, ArrayBuffer] = ['orders', date, bytes.buffer]
const saved = snapshotStorageKey(original, 'memory') as readonly [string, Date, ArrayBuffer]
original[0] = 'changed'
date.setTime(1000)
bytes[0] = 99
console.log('原键:', original[0], date.getTime(), bytes[0])
console.log('快照:', saved[0], saved[1].getTime(), new Uint8Array(saved[2])[0])
console.log('独立数组:', saved !== original)

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
原键: changed 1000 99
快照: orders 0 7
独立数组: true

blocks.text: 依次输出 `原键: changed 1000 99`、`快照: orders 0 7`、`独立数组: true`。修改原数组、日期与字节都没有改变已捕获的键。调用方仍持有可变快照，操作期间应自行保管它。

sections.id: 把普通对象作为记录键前先拒绝
sections.heading: 把普通对象作为记录键前先拒绝

blocks.text: 应用把普通对象当作记录键，直到后端开始工作才失败。手写字符串转换又可能把不同对象压成相同的键。`snapshotStorageKey()` 以 `INVALID_KEY` 拒绝对象，并保留后端标签、原值与类型错误原因；应改用由标量字段组成的数组等有效键。
`candidate` 是不被键域接受的普通对象。`memory` 仍只是后端标签，`orderKey` 覆盖默认 label `key`，只影响错误文字。错误码、backend、key 和 cause 来自本包的契约错误。
输出：

blocks.code:
错误码: INVALID_KEY
后端: memory
原始键: true
类型原因: true

blocks.text: 依次输出 `错误码: INVALID_KEY`、`后端: memory`、`原始键: true`、`类型原因: true`。无效值在同步调用时被拒绝，函数没有调用存储后端。

sections.id: 只读取一次操作选项-把取消执行留给后端
sections.heading: 只读取一次操作选项，把取消执行留给后端

blocks.text: 通过访问器提供的选项可能在校验和使用之间变化，各层重读又可能得到不同的超时或策略。`snapshotOperationContext()` 只读取一次四个字段并冻结记录；再次传入该快照会复用同一对象。已取消的信号仍可被接纳，因为函数只校验意图，实际取消与超时由后端实现。
本例四个字段各由一个 getter 提供：signal 是原生 AbortSignal，timeoutMs 为允许的 0，pageSize 为 1–4096 内的 100，conflictPolicy 为 `replace`（覆盖）。字段省略都保持 undefined；另一策略 `conflict` 表示已存在则失败。取消和计时由实际后端执行。
输出：

blocks.code:
冻结: true
复用快照: true
字段读取次数: 4
信号已取消: true
选项: 0 100 replace

blocks.text: 依次输出 `冻结: true`、`复用快照: true`、`字段读取次数: 4`、`信号已取消: true`、`选项: 0 100 replace`。两次调用合计每字段只读取一次，保留原信号且允许零超时；函数没有建立定时器或取消订阅。

sections.heading: 从文本恢复嵌套的 Map 与 Set

blocks.text: 权限对象中的 `Map`、`Set` 经普通 JSON 序列化后变成空对象。手写替换器和还原器又必须协调集合标记及嵌套规则。`collectionsJsonCodec` 在编码和解码两端使用同一版本元组格式，在其余部分兼容 JSON 的数据中保留这些集合类型。
`encode(value, ctx?)` 将本例对象转成文本，`decode(raw, ctx?)` 接收该文本并恢复集合。两个 ctx 省略时都是 undefined。output 固定为 `text`；这里的类型断言只说明预期对象形状，Map/Set 实例由 codec 的还原器创建。

blocks.code:
import { collectionsJsonCodec } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const settings = { roles: new Map([['Ada', new Set(['read', 'write'])]]) }
const raw = await collectionsJsonCodec.encode(settings)
const restored = (await collectionsJsonCodec.decode(raw)) as typeof settings
console.log('输出形式:', collectionsJsonCodec.output)
console.log('Map:', restored.roles instanceof Map)
console.log('Set:', restored.roles.get('Ada') instanceof Set)
console.log('权限:', [...(restored.roles.get('Ada') ?? [])].join(', '))

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
输出形式: text
Map: true
Set: true
权限: read, write

blocks.text: 依次输出 `输出形式: text`、`Map: true`、`Set: true`、`权限: read, write`。编解码器从字符串中恢复两种嵌套集合，不负责保存字符串。其余值仍受 JSON 能力边界限制，不支持循环引用。

sections.id: 选择通道前规范化旧版能力描述
sections.heading: 选择通道前规范化旧版能力描述

blocks.text: 在二级索引和变更流支持之前创建的能力描述缺少两个新标志。只检查真假会掩盖字段类型错误，继续持有原描述又会让后续修改改变接纳判断。`snapshotStorageCapabilities()` 校验完整形状，只把这两个旧版缺失字段补为 `false`，并返回独立记录。
输入必须包含 syncRead、binary、records、transactions、iteration、opaqueEntries 的布尔值，以及 maxValueBytes 的非负安全整数或 undefined。本例省略旧版尚无的 secondaryIndexes/changeFeed，快照将二者补为 false。完整字段含义见后文能力描述符表。

blocks.code:
import { snapshotStorageCapabilities } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const legacy = {
  syncRead: true,
  binary: false,
  records: false,
  transactions: false,
  iteration: false,
  opaqueEntries: false,
  maxValueBytes: undefined
}
const snapshot = snapshotStorageCapabilities(legacy)
legacy.records = true
console.log('新增标志:', snapshot?.secondaryIndexes, snapshot?.changeFeed)
console.log('记录能力:', legacy.records, snapshot?.records)
console.log('独立记录:', snapshot !== legacy)
console.log('冻结:', Object.isFrozen(snapshot))

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
新增标志: false false
记录能力: true false
独立记录: true
冻结: false

blocks.text: 依次输出 `新增标志: false false`、`记录能力: true false`、`独立记录: true`、`冻结: false`。原描述修改后，捕获的标志仍保留接纳时的值。形状无效或访问器失败返回 `undefined`，成功返回的快照自身仍可修改。

sections.id: 报告契约错误时保留原始失败
sections.heading: 报告契约错误时保留原始失败

blocks.text: 校验边界捕获原生失败后只报告消息，调用方无法再检查原始原因。手写诊断字段也容易遗漏来源和错误码。用相应公开错误码及原始 `cause` 构造 `StorageContractError`，由它持有稳定身份字段和原生原因链。
第一个参数是公开码 INVALID_ARGUMENT；第二个参数的 backend 为 `memory`，cause 为同一个 TypeError。可选 key 本例省略，默认 undefined；details 默认空对象。可选第三个 message 省略，使用由 code 生成的默认消息。冻结错误实例不会冻结 cause。

blocks.code:
import { StorageContractError, StorageContractErrorCode } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const cause = new TypeError('分页大小无效')
const error = new StorageContractError(StorageContractErrorCode.invalidArgument, {
  backend: 'memory',
  cause
})
console.log('来源:', error.source)
console.log('错误码:', error.code)
console.log('后端:', error.backend)
console.log('保留原错:', error.cause === cause)
console.log('原错消息:', (error.cause as Error).message)
console.log('冻结:', Object.isFrozen(error))

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
来源: @migaia/storage-contract
错误码: INVALID_ARGUMENT
后端: memory
保留原错: true
原错消息: 分页大小无效
冻结: true

blocks.text: 依次输出 `来源: @migaia/storage-contract`、`错误码: INVALID_ARGUMENT`、`后端: memory`、`保留原错: true`、`原错消息: 分页大小无效`、`冻结: true`。原生原因链指向同一个原始对象。错误实例已冻结，但不会冻结原因对象。
本包只有根入口 `@migaia/storage-contract`，没有子路径导出。它提供存储接口、能力描述、键域、操作上下文、编解码器接口、事务作用域和契约错误，也提供校验与快照函数、集合 JSON 编解码器。运行时依赖 `@migaia/utils`；结构化取消信号类型 `IAbortSignal` 来自 `@migaia/utils/promise`。
这里没有持久化后端，不打开数据库、不写磁盘，不依赖 DOM、IndexedDB 或 Node。真正的连接、读写、提交、隔离与重试属于实现包，例如 `@migaia/storage-web`。功能模块依赖接口；实现包依赖这份契约，契约不反向依赖实现。压缩、加密或 Worker 重编码可以实现同一个 codec 接口接入，但本包不实现这些扩展。
L0 指所有后端提供的字符串键值通道；L1 指额外提供字节、结构化记录、迭代与事务的通道。能力描述说“能做什么”，不是按后端名字猜测。收窄函数检查描述符和可调用方法，不执行后端读写。
`IBackendKind` 只允许 `'local'`、`'session'`、`'cookie'`、`'indexeddb'`、`'memory'`。`IKeyValueStore` 的只读 `backend`、`capabilities` 描述后端与能力。下表的 key 均为字符串；异步方法的 ctx 默认 `undefined`，字段见操作上下文。

value 为字符串，ctx 使用 IWriteOptions，返回 `Promise<void>`。
只清字符串值通道，返回 `Promise<void>`。

可选 ISyncKeyValueStore；仅同步后端提供，异步后端为 undefined。

blocks.text: `ISyncKeyValueStore` 有 `get(key): string | null`、`set(key, value, options?): void`、`remove(key): void`、`has(key): boolean`、`keys(): string[]`、`clearValues(): void`。同步 set 的唯一选项为 conflictPolicy，不接受有效 signal 或 timeoutMs。local、session、memory、cookie 等同步后端可暴露 sync；IndexedDB 等异步后端不提供它。`ISyncCapableStore<TStore>` 把某个 store 变体的可选 sync 字段收紧为必有，供实现方工厂标注返回类型，不创建同步实现。
`IRecordStore<TValue>` 保留完整 L0，增加下列成员。TValue 默认 unknown；记录主键使用 IStorageKey，字节与元数据仍用字符串键。

sections.heading: 运行时准入与能力收窄

blocks.text: 准入一次读取相关属性，Detailed 保留精确的反射或 getter 失败原因。轻量谓词和快照返回失败结果；as 断言抛 StorageContractError，并把原始访问器错误保留在标准 cause。`asRecordStore` 的 backend 是探测到的合法后端名，探测失败为 undefined。说明快照不冻结原 store，也不证明后端方法的实现结果；已经拿到说明的组合方应复用它，避免再次触发同一 getter。

`IStorageCapabilities` 的九个字段均只读。snapshotStorageCapabilities(value) 接收 unknown，只读取一次并返回新说明对象；不是原引用，也不保证 Object.freeze。字段访问失败或类型非法返回 undefined，不抛错。`isStorageCapabilities(value)` 等价于该快照函数成功与否的布尔判断，不会把规范化字段写回原对象。

sections.id: 操作上下文-写选项与快照
sections.heading: 操作上下文、写选项与快照

blocks.text: `IOperationContext` 是异步方法末尾的可选参数；`IWriteOptions` 额外允许 conflictPolicy。

rows: undefined。结构兼容 IAbortSignal：aborted 为 boolean，addEventListener/removeEventListener 为函数。保留原信号引用。
undefined；提供时为非负安全整数，允许 0。实现层负责超时计时和与外部信号组合，本包只校验。
undefined；提供时必须为 1 到 4096 的整数，用于实现层的分页迭代。
快照未提供时仍为 undefined；写入契约的缺省策略为 conflict。合法值是 'conflict'、'replace' 或 undefined。

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy.conflict` 的值为 `'conflict'`，表示已存在则失败；`ConflictPolicy.replace` 的值为 `'replace'`，表示覆盖。使用该常量和 IConflictPolicy，不另造重复常量或别名。

`snapshotOperationContext(ctx)` 接受上下文或 undefined。undefined 原样返回；合法对象的 signal、timeoutMs、pageSize、conflictPolicy 各读一次，返回冻结快照。再次传入本函数产物会返回同一个对象，不重复读取原 getter。非法对象、字段、信号结构或 getter 失败抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，原始原因通过 cause 保留。`assertOperationContext(ctx)` 调用相同校验，只丢弃返回值。
冻结的是上下文字段，不是信号状态。已经 aborted 的有效信号也能通过形状校验；本包不等待操作、不启动计时器、不创建取消引擎。取消感知后端用 ABORTED 结束等待，不保证原生 AbortError；已经进入原子提交的写应报告真实提交结果，不伪报回滚。

`ISyncWriteOptions` 只允许可选 conflictPolicy。`snapshotSyncWriteOptions(options)` 接受对象或 undefined，读取 signal、timeoutMs、conflictPolicy，拒绝非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs；显式的 undefined 字段合法。额外 pageSize 不读取，也不提供同步分页。返回新对象 { conflictPolicy }，不冻结，省略策略仍为 undefined；`assertSyncWriteOptions(options)` 只校验、不返回快照。非法结构、字段或 getter 失败均为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

blocks.text: `ICodec<T, TRaw>` 的 T 默认 unknown，TRaw 声明默认值为 string | Uint8Array | unknown（等效 unknown）。它有必填 name、output、encode、decode；encode(value, ctx?) 返回 `Promise<TRaw>`，decode(raw, ctx?) 返回 `Promise<T>`。ctx 默认 undefined，使用操作上下文。`ICodecOutput` 的三个值为 text（文本）、binary（二进制）、structured（结构化值）。调用方按输出形态和后端能力选路；本包不把不支持的形态隐式转成其他形态。

`snapshotCodec(codec)` 接受 unknown；要求非 null、非数组的对象，也接纳满足结构的 class 实例。name 必须是 trim 后非空字符串，output 是三种值之一，encode/decode 必须可调用。四个属性各读取一次，返回新的浅说明对象 { name, output, encode, decode }；函数引用不变，不绑定旧 receiver，也不冻结。`assertCodec(codec)` 使用相同校验并将输入类型收窄，不返回说明对象。非法形状或读取失败为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

`collectionsJsonCodec` 是内置、冻结的 codec，name 固定为 `COLLECTIONS_JSON_CODEC_NAME`，即 `'migaia-collections-json-v1'`，output 为 text。Map 和 Set 编为带版本名、map/set kind 与数组 payload 的三元 tuple；解码只解释完全匹配的保留形式。普通或仅相似数组不猜成集合；精确匹配该保留形式的数组会被解释为集合，因此不要把这组 tuple 当普通业务数组使用。
集合之外仍遵循 JSON 表达能力，不是任意对象图的无损序列化。无法表示的根值、循环、BigInt 等 JSON 编码失败，非字符串输入、坏 JSON 或坏保留集合内容，都以 INVALID_ARGUMENT 保留原始 cause。浏览器 structured/binary codec 属于 storage-web；压缩、加密等自定义 codec 实现同一接口接入，不在本包提供。

blocks.text: 中文
Give features and storage implementations shared interfaces, key rules and validation boundaries, with a text codec that preserves Map/Set. Backends perform the actual storage operations.

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: Changing backends forces changes in feature code because features depend on concrete implementations without a shared interface.
Permissions read from JSON lose their Map/Set types because native JSON has no collection representation.
A key changes while an async write is waiting because the operation still shares the caller’s array, Date or buffer.
Layers observe different timeouts or conflict policies because they reread changing option getters.
Logs retain only a failure message because a boundary discards the original cause and stable error identity.
Collection types survive a text round trip. Native JSON loses Map/Set values; the built-in codec uses one versioned tuple format at both ends and restores nested types. Run the example.
Mutable key components stop sharing the caller’s objects. A shallow array copy still shares Dates and buffers; key snapshots recursively copy and revalidate them. Run the example.

Capability decisions use one admitted description. Truthy checks can accept invalid fields, and retaining the input lets later mutation change a decision. Capability snapshots validate fields, default only two legacy flags to false and return a separate record. Run the example.

An operation has one captured option record. Rereading getters can change intent; context snapshots read fields once, freeze the record and reuse it, leaving cancellation execution to backends. Run the example.
Failures retain the exact original object. Message-only errors lose the diagnostic chain; contract errors preserve stable source/code fields and the exact cause. Run the example.

blocks.text: Encode nested permissions as text, then restore actual collection instances:

blocks.code:
import { collectionsJsonCodec } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const settings = { roles: new Map([['Ada', new Set(['read', 'write'])]]) }
const raw = await collectionsJsonCodec.encode(settings)
const restored = (await collectionsJsonCodec.decode(raw)) as typeof settings
console.log('output:', collectionsJsonCodec.output)
console.log('Map:', restored.roles instanceof Map)
console.log('Set:', restored.roles.get('Ada') instanceof Set)
console.log('permissions:', [...(restored.roles.get('Ada') ?? [])].join(', '))

Map: true
Set: true
permissions: read, write

blocks.text: For keys that change during async work, see key snapshots; for repeated option reads, see context snapshots.
Using native JSON on the same permission data exposes these pitfalls. This example is displayed and type-checked only; it is not executed:

blocks.code:
const settings = { roles: new Map([['Ada', new Set(['read', 'write'])]]) }
const raw = JSON.stringify(settings) // Pitfall: Map entries disappear into an empty object, including the nested Set.
const restored = JSON.parse(raw) as typeof settings // Pitfall: a type assertion cannot reconstruct runtime collections.
console.log(restored.roles.get('Ada')) // Pitfall: roles is a plain object, so get throws.

blocks.text: The codec above owns the version tags and collection revival, so callers do not maintain separate replacers and revivers. It still follows JSON’s data-model limits, does not support cycles and does not persist the text.

blocks.text: A “contract” is the input, output and error agreement between caller and implementation. A “capability” describes operations actually available on an object. “Narrowing” checks an object before using a more specific interface. A “snapshot” captures current values; its API determines copying and freezing. A “codec” translates values to and from a storage representation.

Read operation options once without claiming to execute cancellation
Restore nested Map and Set values from text

Keep the original failure when reporting a contract error

blocks.text: Inside the workspace, use `@migaia/storage-contract@workspace:^`. The runtime dependency is `@migaia/utils`. Choose an implementation module when you need an actual backend.

rows: Define the L0/L1 boundary between features and implementations
Verify complete capabilities before calling record methods
Round-trip Map/Set inside JSON-compatible data through text
Validate and copy a key before async work
Admit capability descriptions and report traceable contract failures

blocks.text: The module has one root entry, `@migaia/storage-contract`, with no public subpaths. It provides storage interfaces, capability descriptions, key domains, operation contexts, codecs, transaction scopes and contract errors, plus validators, snapshot helpers and a collection JSON codec. Its runtime dependency is `@migaia/utils`; the structural `IAbortSignal` type comes from `@migaia/utils/promise`.

There is no persistence backend here. It opens no database, writes no disk, and depends on neither DOM nor IndexedDB nor Node. Connections, reads, writes, commits, isolation and retry belong to implementations such as `@migaia/storage-web`. Features depend on these interfaces; implementations depend on the contract, never the reverse. Compression, encryption or Worker recoding can implement the same codec interface, but those extensions are not supplied here.

L0 means the string key-value channel shared by all backends. L1 adds bytes, structured records, iteration and transactions. Capabilities describe available operations instead of asking callers to guess from a backend name. Narrowing checks descriptors and callable methods without performing storage operations.

`IBackendKind` accepts only `'local'`, `'session'`, `'cookie'`, `'indexeddb'` and `'memory'`. Read-only `backend` and `capabilities` identify an IKeyValueStore's backend and abilities. Keys in this table are strings. Async ctx arguments default to undefined; their fields are described below.

blocks.text: `ISyncKeyValueStore` provides `get(key): string | null`, `set(key, value, options?): void`, `remove(key): void`, `has(key): boolean`, `keys(): string[]` and `clearValues(): void`. Sync set accepts only conflictPolicy, without a meaningful signal or timeoutMs. Synchronous local, session, memory and cookie backends may expose sync; asynchronous IndexedDB does not. `ISyncCapableStore<TStore>` makes a store variant's optional sync field required for a backend factory's return type; it creates no sync implementation.
`IRecordStore<TValue>` retains all L0 members and adds the following. TValue defaults to unknown. Record keys use IStorageKey; byte and metadata keys remain strings.

blocks.text: Admission reads relevant properties once. Detailed results retain exact reflection or getter failures. Predicates and lightweight snapshots return a failure value; as assertions throw StorageContractError with the original accessor error on cause. asRecordStore reports the detected valid backend, or undefined if unavailable. A description snapshot freezes neither the original store nor its implementation behavior. Composing callers should reuse an admitted description instead of reading the same getters again.

`IStorageCapabilities` has nine read-only fields. snapshotStorageCapabilities(value) takes unknown, reads once and returns a new description, not the original object. It is not guaranteed to be frozen. Invalid types or failing accessors return undefined rather than throwing. `isStorageCapabilities(value)` tests whether snapshot admission succeeds; it does not write normalized fields back to the input.

blocks.text: Existing backend descriptions use approximately 4096 bytes for cookies and 5 MB for localStorage; IndexedDB commonly uses undefined because total quota is the main limit. These describe capabilities, not quotas measured or implemented by this module.
`IOperationContext` is the optional final argument to async operations. `IWriteOptions` additionally permits conflictPolicy.

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy.conflict` is `'conflict'`: fail when a value already exists. `ConflictPolicy.replace` is `'replace'`: replace it. Use this constant and IConflictPolicy instead of duplicate constants or aliases.

`snapshotOperationContext(ctx)` accepts a context or undefined. Undefined stays undefined. For a valid object it reads signal, timeoutMs, pageSize and conflictPolicy once, then returns a frozen snapshot. Passing one of its own snapshots again returns that exact object without rereading original getters. Invalid objects, fields, signal shapes or getter failures throw INVALID_ARGUMENT, retaining the original cause. `assertOperationContext(ctx)` performs the same validation but discards the result.

Only context fields are frozen, not signal state. A structurally valid already-aborted signal still passes admission. This module neither waits for operations nor starts timers or a cancellation engine. Cancellation-aware backends use ABORTED to stop waiting, without promising a native AbortError. A write already inside atomic commit reports its actual commit outcome rather than claiming rollback.

`ISyncWriteOptions` permits only optional conflictPolicy. `snapshotSyncWriteOptions(options)` takes an object or undefined, reads signal, timeoutMs and conflictPolicy, and rejects non-undefined signal/timeoutMs. Explicit undefined values are accepted. Extra pageSize is not read and grants no synchronous paging. The new { conflictPolicy } object is not frozen, and omission stays undefined. `assertSyncWriteOptions(options)` validates without returning a snapshot. Invalid shapes, fields and getters produce INVALID_ARGUMENT.
`IStorageKey` accepts strings, finite numbers, valid Dates, ArrayBuffers, or nonempty nested read-only arrays of those values. Arrays cannot be sparse or cyclic.

rows: value is unknown. backend is the caller's selected IBackendKind, used for error details. label defaults to 'key' for error text. Invalid input throws INVALID_KEY with the original key.
Same inputs. Validates, copies Dates, ArrayBuffers and nested arrays, then validates again. Strings/numbers remain unchanged. Mutable inputs are detached from the result, which is not frozen.
L0, byte and metadata channels require string keys. label defaults to 'key'. Non-strings produce INVALID_ARGUMENT rather than INVALID_KEY.
Takes two valid IStorageKey values and returns a negative number, zero or positive number for sort. It does not promise only -1/0/1.
1,048,576 bytes for each binary key component.

blocks.text: Dates must have a valid timestamp; numbers must be finite. Date and binary classification use structuredClone when available for cross-realm input. Without it, Date classification uses local Date identity. Binary branding comes from utils/bytes; a forged constructor.name is insufficient. Copy or revalidation failures become INVALID_KEY; existing StorageContractErrors pass through.

Type ordering is number < Date < string < ArrayBuffer < array. Numbers compare by difference, Dates by timestamp and strings lexically. Binary values compare byte by byte; equal prefixes favor the shorter value. Arrays compare recursively by element, with shorter equal prefixes first.

`IKeyRange` has optional lower/upper IStorageKey bounds and boolean lowerOpen/upperOpen flags to exclude their respective endpoints. It follows IDBKeyRange semantics without depending on that host type. This module fills no omitted defaults; the implementation interprets them.

`ICodec<T, TRaw>` defaults T to unknown and TRaw to string | Uint8Array | unknown (effectively unknown). It requires name, output, encode and decode. encode(value, ctx?) returns `Promise<TRaw>`; decode(raw, ctx?) returns `Promise<T>`. Context defaults to undefined and follows the operation-context shape. `ICodecOutput` is text, binary or structured. Callers route by output and backend capabilities; this module performs no implicit conversion to make an unsupported representation fit.

`snapshotCodec(codec)` takes unknown. It requires a non-null, non-array object, including a class instance satisfying the shape. name must be nonblank after trimming, output must be one of the three values, and encode/decode must be callable. Each of the four fields is read once. The new shallow { name, output, encode, decode } description retains function references without binding their old receiver and is not frozen. `assertCodec(codec)` checks the same shape and narrows the input type without returning a description. Bad shapes and reads produce INVALID_ARGUMENT.

`collectionsJsonCodec` is the built-in frozen codec. Its name is `COLLECTIONS_JSON_CODEC_NAME`, or `'migaia-collections-json-v1'`, and output is text. Maps and Sets become three-item tuples containing that version name, a map/set kind and an array payload. Decoding interprets only the exact reserved forms. Ordinary or merely similar arrays are left alone; arrays exactly matching the reserved form are interpreted as collections, so that tuple form is unavailable as ordinary application data.

Other values retain JSON's limits: this is not lossless serialization of arbitrary object graphs. Unrepresentable roots, cycles, BigInts and other JSON encoding failures produce INVALID_ARGUMENT, as do non-string input, invalid JSON and invalid reserved collection payloads. Original failures stay on cause. Browser structured/binary codecs belong to storage-web. Custom compression, encryption and Worker codecs implement the same interface outside this module.

`ITransactionScope<TValue>` has only get(key): `Promise<TValue | undefined>`, put(value, key?, options?): `Promise<IStorageKey>`, and delete(key): `Promise<void>`. Keys are IStorageKey; omitted put keys are generated by the implementation. `ITransactionWriteOptions` has only optional conflictPolicy.

Isolation, commit timing and retry are implementation-defined. This module executes no transaction. Do not retain and use a scope after its callback resolves; its connection or snapshot may have been released. `assertTransactionCallback(run, backend)` checks that run is callable before the implementation allocates resources, otherwise throwing INVALID_ARGUMENT with backend details.

`readTransactionConflictPolicy(options, backend)` takes undefined or an object. Omitted options or conflictPolicy return conflict; replace returns replace. A bare policy string, malformed object or field produces INVALID_ARGUMENT; getter failures preserve the exact cause. It only reads policy and performs no write.

The listener receives post-commit IStorageChange notifications; callers retain and invoke the cancellation function. sequence is an increasing sequence number and origin identifies the source. channel is value, bytes, record or all; kind is put, remove, clear, batch or migrate. Optional scope and keys may be omitted; keys contain IStorageKey values. This declares notifications without creating a channel or cross-window carrier.

Choose a scenario for the problem at hand, then consult interfaces, parameters and implementation responsibilities. These examples use contract tools and the built-in codec without simulating a storage backend.

rows: Capture a composite key before its owner changes it
Reject an object before treating it as a record key
Read operation options once without claiming to execute cancellation
Restore nested Map and Set values from text

Keep the original failure when reporting a contract error

sections.heading: Capture a composite key before its owner changes it

blocks.text: An async operation still holds a caller’s array, Date and buffer, so changing the original can change the key used later. A shallow array copy leaves both nested objects shared. `snapshotStorageKey()` validates and recursively copies these key components, then validates the copy. The returned key is detached, not frozen.

`value` is the caller’s unknown key; here it is an array containing a string, Date and ArrayBuffer. The `memory` backend argument labels diagnostics without creating a memory store. Optional label defaults to `key`. Mutable components are recursively copied, but the result is not frozen.

blocks.code:
import { snapshotStorageKey } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const date = new Date(0)
const bytes = new Uint8Array([7, 8])
const original: [string, Date, ArrayBuffer] = ['orders', date, bytes.buffer]
const saved = snapshotStorageKey(original, 'memory') as readonly [string, Date, ArrayBuffer]
original[0] = 'changed'
date.setTime(1000)
bytes[0] = 99
console.log('original:', original[0], date.getTime(), bytes[0])
console.log('snapshot:', saved[0], saved[1].getTime(), new Uint8Array(saved[2])[0])
console.log('separate array:', saved !== original)

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
original: changed 1000 99
snapshot: orders 0 7
separate array: true

blocks.text: Prints `original: changed 1000 99`, `snapshot: orders 0 7`, then `separate array: true`. Mutation of the original array, Date and bytes does not change the captured key. The caller still owns the mutable snapshot; keep it private for the duration of the operation.

sections.heading: Reject an object before treating it as a record key

blocks.text: An application sends an object as a record key and fails only after backend work starts. Handwritten string conversion can collapse different objects to the same key. `snapshotStorageKey()` rejects the object with `INVALID_KEY`, retaining the backend label, original value and typed cause. Choose a supported key such as an array of its scalar fields instead.

`candidate` is a plain object outside the accepted key domain. `memory` is still only a backend label. `orderKey` replaces the default label `key` in diagnostic text. The resulting contract error supplies code, backend, key and cause.
Output:

blocks.code:
code: INVALID_KEY
backend: memory
original key: true
typed cause: true

blocks.text: Prints `code: INVALID_KEY`, `backend: memory`, `original key: true`, then `typed cause: true`. The invalid value is rejected synchronously; this helper does not call a storage backend.

sections.heading: Read operation options once without claiming to execute cancellation

blocks.text: Options supplied through getters can change between validation and use. Re-reading them in each backend layer can select inconsistent timeouts or policies. `snapshotOperationContext()` captures the four fields once and freezes their record; passing that snapshot back reuses its identity. It accepts an already-aborted signal because it validates intent only: the backend must implement cancellation and timeout behavior.

The four getters provide the original AbortSignal, an allowed zero timeout, a pageSize of 100 within 1–4096, and `replace` to permit replacement. Omitted fields remain undefined. The other policy, `conflict`, fails when a value already exists. Actual cancellation and timers belong to a backend.
Output:

blocks.code:
frozen: true
same snapshot: true
field reads: 4
signal aborted: true
options: 0 100 replace

blocks.text: Prints `frozen: true`, `same snapshot: true`, `field reads: 4`, `signal aborted: true`, then `options: 0 100 replace`. Each field is read once across both calls; validation preserves the original signal and accepts zero timeout. No timer or abort subscription is created.

sections.heading: Restore nested Map and Set values from text

blocks.text: A permissions object becomes plain empty objects when its Map and Set are sent through ordinary JSON serialization. A custom replacer and reviver must agree on collection tags and nesting. `collectionsJsonCodec` uses its versioned tuple format for both operations, preserving these collection types inside otherwise JSON-compatible data.

`encode(value, ctx?)` turns this object into text; `decode(raw, ctx?)` consumes that text and reconstructs collections. Both omitted context arguments are undefined. output is always `text`. The type assertion describes the expected object shape; the codec reviver creates the Map/Set instances.

blocks.code:
import { collectionsJsonCodec } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const settings = { roles: new Map([['Ada', new Set(['read', 'write'])]]) }
const raw = await collectionsJsonCodec.encode(settings)
const restored = (await collectionsJsonCodec.decode(raw)) as typeof settings
console.log('output:', collectionsJsonCodec.output)
console.log('Map:', restored.roles instanceof Map)
console.log('Set:', restored.roles.get('Ada') instanceof Set)
console.log('permissions:', [...(restored.roles.get('Ada') ?? [])].join(', '))

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
output: text
Map: true
Set: true
permissions: read, write

blocks.text: Prints `output: text`, `Map: true`, `Set: true`, then `permissions: read, write`. The codec restores both nested collection types from a string; it does not store the string anywhere. Other values retain JSON limitations, and cycles are not supported.

sections.heading: Normalize an older capability descriptor before choosing a channel

blocks.text: A capability descriptor created before index and change-feed support omits the new flags. Truthy checks can hide invalid field types, while retaining the descriptor lets later mutation change an admission decision. `snapshotStorageCapabilities()` validates the full shape, defaults only the two legacy flags to false and returns a separate record.

Input requires boolean syncRead, binary, records, transactions, iteration and opaqueEntries, plus a nonnegative safe-integer maxValueBytes or undefined. The legacy object omits secondaryIndexes/changeFeed, so the snapshot supplies false for each. The full field meanings appear in the capability table below.

blocks.code:
import { snapshotStorageCapabilities } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const legacy = {
  syncRead: true,
  binary: false,
  records: false,
  transactions: false,
  iteration: false,
  opaqueEntries: false,
  maxValueBytes: undefined
}
const snapshot = snapshotStorageCapabilities(legacy)
legacy.records = true
console.log('new flags:', snapshot?.secondaryIndexes, snapshot?.changeFeed)
console.log('record capability:', legacy.records, snapshot?.records)
console.log('separate record:', snapshot !== legacy)
console.log('frozen:', Object.isFrozen(snapshot))

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
new flags: false false
record capability: true false
separate record: true
frozen: false

blocks.text: Prints `new flags: false false`, `record capability: true false`, `separate record: true`, then `frozen: false`. The captured flags retain their admission-time values after the original descriptor changes. Invalid shapes or accessor failures return `undefined`; the successful snapshot itself remains mutable.

sections.heading: Keep the original failure when reporting a contract error

blocks.text: A validation boundary catches a native failure but reports only a message, leaving callers unable to inspect its original cause. Rebuilding diagnostic fields by hand can also lose the source and code. Construct `StorageContractError` with the appropriate public code and exact cause; it owns the stable identity fields and native cause link.

The first argument is public code INVALID_ARGUMENT. The second supplies the `memory` backend label and the exact TypeError as cause. Optional key is omitted and remains undefined; details defaults to an empty object. The optional third message is omitted, selecting the code-based default. Freezing the error does not freeze its cause.

blocks.code:
import { StorageContractError, StorageContractErrorCode } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const cause = new TypeError('invalid page size')
const error = new StorageContractError(StorageContractErrorCode.invalidArgument, {
  backend: 'memory',
  cause
})
console.log('source:', error.source)
console.log('code:', error.code)
console.log('backend:', error.backend)
console.log('same cause:', error.cause === cause)
console.log('cause message:', (error.cause as Error).message)
console.log('frozen:', Object.isFrozen(error))

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
source: @migaia/storage-contract
code: INVALID_ARGUMENT
backend: memory
same cause: true
cause message: invalid page size
frozen: true

blocks.text: Prints `source: @migaia/storage-contract`, `code: INVALID_ARGUMENT`, `backend: memory`, `same cause: true`, `cause message: invalid page size`, then `frozen: true`. The native cause is the exact original object. The error instance is frozen; this does not freeze the cause object.

The module has one root entry, `@migaia/storage-contract`, with no public subpaths. It provides storage interfaces, capability descriptions, key domains, operation contexts, codecs, transaction scopes and contract errors, plus validators, snapshot helpers and a collection JSON codec. Its runtime dependency is `@migaia/utils`; the structural `IAbortSignal` type comes from `@migaia/utils/promise`.

There is no persistence backend here. It opens no database, writes no disk, and depends on neither DOM nor IndexedDB nor Node. Connections, reads, writes, commits, isolation and retry belong to implementations such as `@migaia/storage-web`. Features depend on these interfaces; implementations depend on the contract, never the reverse. Compression, encryption or Worker recoding can implement the same codec interface, but those extensions are not supplied here.

L0 means the string key-value channel shared by all backends. L1 adds bytes, structured records, iteration and transactions. Capabilities describe available operations instead of asking callers to guess from a backend name. Narrowing checks descriptors and callable methods without performing storage operations.

`IBackendKind` accepts only `'local'`, `'session'`, `'cookie'`, `'indexeddb'` and `'memory'`. Read-only `backend` and `capabilities` identify an IKeyValueStore's backend and abilities. Keys in this table are strings. Async ctx arguments default to undefined; their fields are described below.

Without it, Date classification uses local Date identity. Binary branding comes from utils/bytes; a forged constructor.name is insufficient. Copy or revalidation failures become INVALID_KEY; existing StorageContractErrors pass through.

Type ordering is number < Date < string < ArrayBuffer < array. Numbers compare by difference, Dates by timestamp and strings lexically. Binary values compare byte by byte; equal prefixes favor the shorter value. Arrays compare recursively by element, with shorter equal prefixes first.

`ICodec<T, TRaw>` defaults T to unknown and TRaw to string | Uint8Array | unknown (effectively unknown). It requires name, output, encode and decode. encode(value, ctx?) returns `Promise<TRaw>`; decode(raw, ctx?) returns `Promise<T>`. Context defaults to undefined and follows the operation-context shape. `ICodecOutput` is text, binary or structured. Callers route by output and backend capabilities; this module performs no implicit conversion to make an unsupported representation fit.

It requires a non-null, non-array object, including a class instance satisfying the shape. name must be nonblank after trimming, output must be one of the three values, and encode/decode must be callable. Each of the four fields is read once. guidance.heading: 操作上下文、写选项与快照

blocks.text: `IOperationContext` 是异步方法末尾的可选参数；`IWriteOptions` 额外允许 conflictPolicy。

rows: undefined。结构兼容 IAbortSignal：aborted 为 boolean，addEventListener/removeEventListener 为函数。保留原信号引用。
undefined；提供时为非负安全整数，允许 0。实现层负责超时计时和与外部信号组合，本包只校验。
undefined；提供时必须为 1 到 4096 的整数，用于实现层的分页迭代。
快照未提供时仍为 undefined；写入契约的缺省策略为 conflict。合法值是 'conflict'、'replace' 或 undefined。

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy.conflict` 的值为 `'conflict'`，表示已存在则失败；`ConflictPolicy.replace` 的值为 `'replace'`，表示覆盖。使用该常量和 IConflictPolicy，不另造重复常量或别名。

`snapshotOperationContext(ctx)` 接受上下文或 undefined。undefined 原样返回；合法对象的 signal、timeoutMs、pageSize、conflictPolicy 各读一次，返回冻结快照。再次传入本函数产物会返回同一个对象，不重复读取原 getter。非法对象、字段、信号结构或 getter 失败抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，原始原因通过 cause 保留。`assertOperationContext(ctx)` 调用相同校验，只丢弃返回值。
冻结的是上下文字段，不是信号状态。已经 aborted 的有效信号也能通过形状校验；本包不等待操作、不启动计时器、不创建取消引擎。取消感知后端用 ABORTED 结束等待，不保证原生 AbortError；已经进入原子提交的写应报告真实提交结果，不伪报回滚。

`ISyncWriteOptions` 只允许可选 conflictPolicy。`snapshotSyncWriteOptions(options)` 接受对象或 undefined，读取 signal、timeoutMs、conflictPolicy，拒绝非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs；显式的 undefined 字段合法。额外 pageSize 不读取，也不提供同步分页。返回新对象 { conflictPolicy }，不冻结，省略策略仍为 undefined；`assertSyncWriteOptions(options)` 只校验、不返回快照。非法结构、字段或 getter 失败均为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

blocks.text: `IOperationContext` 是异步方法末尾的可选参数；`IWriteOptions` 额外允许 conflictPolicy。

rows: undefined。结构兼容 IAbortSignal：aborted 为 boolean，addEventListener/removeEventListener 为函数。保留原信号引用。
undefined；提供时为非负安全整数，允许 0。实现层负责超时计时和与外部信号组合，本包只校验。
undefined；提供时必须为 1 到 4096 的整数，用于实现层的分页迭代。
快照未提供时仍为 undefined；写入契约的缺省策略为 conflict。合法值是 'conflict'、'replace' 或 undefined。

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy.conflict` 的值为 `'conflict'`，表示已存在则失败；`ConflictPolicy.replace` 的值为 `'replace'`，表示覆盖。使用该常量和 IConflictPolicy，不另造重复常量或别名。

`snapshotOperationContext(ctx)` 接受上下文或 undefined。undefined 原样返回；合法对象的 signal、timeoutMs、pageSize、conflictPolicy 各读一次，返回冻结快照。再次传入本函数产物会返回同一个对象，不重复读取原 getter。非法对象、字段、信号结构或 getter 失败抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，原始原因通过 cause 保留。`assertOperationContext(ctx)` 调用相同校验，只丢弃返回值。
冻结的是上下文字段，不是信号状态。已经 aborted 的有效信号也能通过形状校验；本包不等待操作、不启动计时器、不创建取消引擎。取消感知后端用 ABORTED 结束等待，不保证原生 AbortError；已经进入原子提交的写应报告真实提交结果，不伪报回滚。

`ISyncWriteOptions` 只允许可选 conflictPolicy。`snapshotSyncWriteOptions(options)` 接受对象或 undefined，读取 signal、timeoutMs、conflictPolicy，拒绝非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs；显式的 undefined 字段合法。额外 pageSize 不读取，也不提供同步分页。返回新对象 { conflictPolicy }，不冻结，省略策略仍为 undefined；`assertSyncWriteOptions(options)` 只校验、不返回快照。非法结构、字段或 getter 失败均为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

guidance.heading: 操作上下文、写选项与快照

blocks.text: `IOperationContext` 是异步方法末尾的可选参数；`IWriteOptions` 额外允许 conflictPolicy。

rows: undefined。结构兼容 IAbortSignal：aborted 为 boolean，addEventListener/removeEventListener 为函数。保留原信号引用。
undefined；提供时为非负安全整数，允许 0。实现层负责超时计时和与外部信号组合，本包只校验。
undefined；提供时必须为 1 到 4096 的整数，用于实现层的分页迭代。
快照未提供时仍为 undefined；写入契约的缺省策略为 conflict。合法值是 'conflict'、'replace' 或 undefined。

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy.conflict` 的值为 `'conflict'`，表示已存在则失败；`ConflictPolicy.replace` 的值为 `'replace'`，表示覆盖。使用该常量和 IConflictPolicy，不另造重复常量或别名。

`snapshotOperationContext(ctx)` 接受上下文或 undefined。undefined 原样返回；合法对象的 signal、timeoutMs、pageSize、conflictPolicy 各读一次，返回冻结快照。再次传入本函数产物会返回同一个对象，不重复读取原 getter。非法对象、字段、信号结构或 getter 失败抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，原始原因通过 cause 保留。`assertOperationContext(ctx)` 调用相同校验，只丢弃返回值。
冻结的是上下文字段，不是信号状态。已经 aborted 的有效信号也能通过形状校验；本包不等待操作、不启动计时器、不创建取消引擎。取消感知后端用 ABORTED 结束等待，不保证原生 AbortError；已经进入原子提交的写应报告真实提交结果，不伪报回滚。

`ISyncWriteOptions` 只允许可选 conflictPolicy。`snapshotSyncWriteOptions(options)` 接受对象或 undefined，读取 signal、timeoutMs、conflictPolicy，拒绝非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs；显式的 undefined 字段合法。额外 pageSize 不读取，也不提供同步分页。返回新对象 { conflictPolicy }，不冻结，省略策略仍为 undefined；`assertSyncWriteOptions(options)` 只校验、不返回快照。非法结构、字段或 getter 失败均为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

blocks.text: `IOperationContext` 是异步方法末尾的可选参数；`IWriteOptions` 额外允许 conflictPolicy。

rows: undefined。结构兼容 IAbortSignal：aborted 为 boolean，addEventListener/removeEventListener 为函数。保留原信号引用。
undefined；提供时为非负安全整数，允许 0。实现层负责超时计时和与外部信号组合，本包只校验。
undefined；提供时必须为 1 到 4096 的整数，用于实现层的分页迭代。
快照未提供时仍为 undefined；写入契约的缺省策略为 conflict。合法值是 'conflict'、'replace' 或 undefined。

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy.conflict` 的值为 `'conflict'`，表示已存在则失败；`ConflictPolicy.replace` 的值为 `'replace'`，表示覆盖。使用该常量和 IConflictPolicy，不另造重复常量或别名。

`snapshotOperationContext(ctx)` 接受上下文或 undefined。undefined 原样返回；合法对象的 signal、timeoutMs、pageSize、conflictPolicy 各读一次，返回冻结快照。再次传入本函数产物会返回同一个对象，不重复读取原 getter。非法对象、字段、信号结构或 getter 失败抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，原始原因通过 cause 保留。`assertOperationContext(ctx)` 调用相同校验，只丢弃返回值。
冻结的是上下文字段，不是信号状态。已经 aborted 的有效信号也能通过形状校验；本包不等待操作、不启动计时器、不创建取消引擎。取消感知后端用 ABORTED 结束等待，不保证原生 AbortError；已经进入原子提交的写应报告真实提交结果，不伪报回滚。

`ISyncWriteOptions` 只允许可选 conflictPolicy。`snapshotSyncWriteOptions(options)` 接受对象或 undefined，读取 signal、timeoutMs、conflictPolicy，拒绝非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs；显式的 undefined 字段合法。额外 pageSize 不读取，也不提供同步分页。返回新对象 { conflictPolicy }，不冻结，省略策略仍为 undefined；`assertSyncWriteOptions(options)` 只校验、不返回快照。非法结构、字段或 getter 失败均为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

blocks.text: `new StorageContractError(code, details?, message?)` 创建错误后立即冻结。code 必填；details 默认 {}，字段 backend、key、cause 都可选，默认 undefined。backend 为 IBackendKind，key 为字符串或 IStorageKey，cause 是原始失败。message 省略时为 `[storage-contract] ${code}`。name 为 StorageContractError，source 恒为 `STORAGE_CONTRACT_SOURCE`，即 `'@migaia/storage-contract'`，不重写 stack，标准 cause 仍可追到原对象。

blocks.text: `IOperationContext` 是异步方法末尾的可选参数；`IWriteOptions` 额外允许 conflictPolicy。

rows: undefined。结构兼容 IAbortSignal：aborted 为 boolean，addEventListener/removeEventListener 为函数。保留原信号引用。
undefined；提供时为非负安全整数，允许 0。实现层负责超时计时和与外部信号组合，本包只校验。
undefined；提供时必须为 1 到 4096 的整数，用于实现层的分页迭代。
快照未提供时仍为 undefined；写入契约的缺省策略为 conflict。合法值是 'conflict'、'replace' 或 undefined。

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy.conflict` 的值为 `'conflict'`，表示已存在则失败；`ConflictPolicy.replace` 的值为 `'replace'`，表示覆盖。使用该常量和 IConflictPolicy，不另造重复常量或别名。

`snapshotOperationContext(ctx)` 接受上下文或 undefined。undefined 原样返回；合法对象的 signal、timeoutMs、pageSize、conflictPolicy 各读一次，返回冻结快照。再次传入本函数产物会返回同一个对象，不重复读取原 getter。非法对象、字段、信号结构或 getter 失败抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，原始原因通过 cause 保留。`assertOperationContext(ctx)` 调用相同校验，只丢弃返回值。
冻结的是上下文字段，不是信号状态。已经 aborted 的有效信号也能通过形状校验；本包不等待操作、不启动计时器、不创建取消引擎。取消感知后端用 ABORTED 结束等待，不保证原生 AbortError；已经进入原子提交的写应报告真实提交结果，不伪报回滚。

`ISyncWriteOptions` 只允许可选 conflictPolicy。`snapshotSyncWriteOptions(options)` 接受对象或 undefined，读取 signal、timeoutMs、conflictPolicy，拒绝非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs；显式的 undefined 字段合法。额外 pageSize 不读取，也不提供同步分页。返回新对象 { conflictPolicy }，不冻结，省略策略仍为 undefined；`assertSyncWriteOptions(options)` 只校验、不返回快照。非法结构、字段或 getter 失败均为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

guidance.id: 只读取一次操作选项-把取消执行留给后端
guidance.heading: 只读取一次操作选项，把取消执行留给后端

blocks.text: 通过访问器提供的选项可能在校验和使用之间变化，各层重读又可能得到不同的超时或策略。`snapshotOperationContext()` 只读取一次四个字段并冻结记录；再次传入该快照会复用同一对象。已取消的信号仍可被接纳，因为函数只校验意图，实际取消与超时由后端实现。
本例四个字段各由一个 getter 提供：signal 是原生 AbortSignal，timeoutMs 为允许的 0，pageSize 为 1–4096 内的 100，conflictPolicy 为 `replace`（覆盖）。字段省略都保持 undefined；另一策略 `conflict` 表示已存在则失败。取消和计时由实际后端执行。
输出：

blocks.code:
冻结: true
复用快照: true
字段读取次数: 4
信号已取消: true
选项: 0 100 replace

blocks.text: 依次输出 `冻结: true`、`复用快照: true`、`字段读取次数: 4`、`信号已取消: true`、`选项: 0 100 replace`。两次调用合计每字段只读取一次，保留原信号且允许零超时；函数没有建立定时器或取消订阅。

guidance.heading: 操作上下文、写选项与快照

blocks.text: `IOperationContext` 是异步方法末尾的可选参数；`IWriteOptions` 额外允许 conflictPolicy。

rows: undefined。结构兼容 IAbortSignal：aborted 为 boolean，addEventListener/removeEventListener 为函数。保留原信号引用。
undefined；提供时为非负安全整数，允许 0。实现层负责超时计时和与外部信号组合，本包只校验。
undefined；提供时必须为 1 到 4096 的整数，用于实现层的分页迭代。
快照未提供时仍为 undefined；写入契约的缺省策略为 conflict。合法值是 'conflict'、'replace' 或 undefined。

blocks.text: `ConflictPolicy.conflict` 的值为 `'conflict'`，表示已存在则失败；`ConflictPolicy.replace` 的值为 `'replace'`，表示覆盖。使用该常量和 IConflictPolicy，不另造重复常量或别名。

`snapshotOperationContext(ctx)` 接受上下文或 undefined。undefined 原样返回；合法对象的 signal、timeoutMs、pageSize、conflictPolicy 各读一次，返回冻结快照。再次传入本函数产物会返回同一个对象，不重复读取原 getter。非法对象、字段、信号结构或 getter 失败抛 INVALID_ARGUMENT，原始原因通过 cause 保留。`assertOperationContext(ctx)` 调用相同校验，只丢弃返回值。
冻结的是上下文字段，不是信号状态。已经 aborted 的有效信号也能通过形状校验；本包不等待操作、不启动计时器、不创建取消引擎。取消感知后端用 ABORTED 结束等待，不保证原生 AbortError；已经进入原子提交的写应报告真实提交结果，不伪报回滚。

`ISyncWriteOptions` 只允许可选 conflictPolicy。`snapshotSyncWriteOptions(options)` 接受对象或 undefined，读取 signal、timeoutMs、conflictPolicy，拒绝非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs；显式的 undefined 字段合法。额外 pageSize 不读取，也不提供同步分页。返回新对象 { conflictPolicy }，不冻结，省略策略仍为 undefined；`assertSyncWriteOptions(options)` 只校验、不返回快照。非法结构、字段或 getter 失败均为 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

symbols.name: snapshotStorageKey
symbols.signature: export declare const snapshotStorageKey: (value: unknown, backend: IBackendKind, label?: string) => IStorageKey;
symbols.purpose: Validates and detaches one record key before asynchronous work can observe later caller mutation. Arrays, dates and binary buffers are copied recursively, then the copy is validated again.
symbols.core:
value: Required unknown candidate from application input. Record keys accept strings, finite numbers, valid `Date`, `ArrayBuffer` up to 1048576 bytes each, or nonempty dense acyclic arrays of these values. Root depth is 0; maximum depth is 32 and maximum visited node count is 4096. The string-only helper accepts only strings. Values are validated without coercion.
backend: Required caller-selected `IBackendKind`: `local`, `session`, `cookie`, `indexeddb` or `memory`, normally from `store.backend`. It labels errors without choosing an implementation or narrowing the record-key domain.
label: Optional caller-selected diagnostic field name, default `key`; affects only error text, not validation or copying.
An independent valid `IStorageKey`, recursively copied but not frozen. Invalid input or failed copying throws `INVALID_KEY` while retaining its cause.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.
examples:
import { snapshotStorageKey } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const date = new Date(0)
const bytes = new Uint8Array([7, 8])
const original: [string, Date, ArrayBuffer] = ['orders', date, bytes.buffer]
const saved = snapshotStorageKey(original, 'memory') as readonly [string, Date, ArrayBuffer]
original[0] = 'changed'
date.setTime(1000)
bytes[0] = 99
console.log('原键:', original[0], date.getTime(), bytes[0])
console.log('快照:', saved[0], saved[1].getTime(), new Uint8Array(saved[2])[0])
console.log('独立数组:', saved !== original)

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Constructs and freezes a native Error carrying storage-contract source, semantic code and optional backend/key context. The native stack and exact original cause remain reachable after construction.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import StorageContractError from @migaia/storage-contract, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use StorageContractError when its class contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when StorageContractError does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained class example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
code: Required semantic value from `StorageContractErrorCode`: `INVALID_ARGUMENT`, `INVALID_KEY`, `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`, `STORE_DISPOSED` or `ABORTED`. The producer chooses the code matching the failed contract.
details: Optional producer-authored details, default `{}`. Optional `backend` is `local`, `session`, `cookie`, `indexeddb` or `memory`; optional `key` is a string or `IStorageKey`; optional `cause` is any original thrown value. All fields default to `undefined`; key and cause are retained by reference without validation or copying.
message: Optional producer-selected diagnostic message; default is exactly `[storage-contract] ${code}` using the supplied semantic code.
A frozen `StorageContractError`; backend and key are direct fields, while cause uses the native Error chain.
source: Fixed `STORAGE_CONTRACT_SOURCE` marker identifying this package’s contract errors.
code: Semantic code selected from `StorageContractErrorCode`; interpret together with the source marker.
backend: Optional backend label supplied in construction details; absent when the producer cannot establish a backend.
Local browser key-value storage whose data normally survives browsing sessions.
Session-scoped browser key-value storage with the host’s session lifetime.
Cookie storage subject to document visibility, scope and small value limits.
Structured browser database backend; inspect capability flags before using record extensions.
In-process memory implementation whose data lifetime is owned by the concrete backend.
key: Optional original application key retained in construction details for diagnosis, not a generated replacement.
Omitted: no backend label is attached.
Omitted: no application key is attached.
cause: Exact original failure supplied by the producer; retained through native Error.cause without replacing the new error stack.
Omitted: native cause is undefined.

guidance.heading: 报告契约错误时保留原始失败

blocks.text: 校验边界捕获原生失败后只报告消息，调用方无法再检查原始原因。手写诊断字段也容易遗漏来源和错误码。用相应公开错误码及原始 `cause` 构造 `StorageContractError`，由它持有稳定身份字段和原生原因链。
第一个参数是公开码 INVALID_ARGUMENT；第二个参数的 backend 为 `memory`，cause 为同一个 TypeError。可选 key 本例省略，默认 undefined；details 默认空对象。可选第三个 message 省略，使用由 code 生成的默认消息。冻结错误实例不会冻结 cause。

blocks.code:
import { StorageContractError, StorageContractErrorCode } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const cause = new TypeError('分页大小无效')
const error = new StorageContractError(StorageContractErrorCode.invalidArgument, {
  backend: 'memory',
  cause
})
console.log('来源:', error.source)
console.log('错误码:', error.code)
console.log('后端:', error.backend)
console.log('保留原错:', error.cause === cause)
console.log('原错消息:', (error.cause as Error).message)
console.log('冻结:', Object.isFrozen(error))

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
来源: @migaia/storage-contract
错误码: INVALID_ARGUMENT
后端: memory
保留原错: true
原错消息: 分页大小无效
冻结: true

blocks.text: 依次输出 `来源: @migaia/storage-contract`、`错误码: INVALID_ARGUMENT`、`后端: memory`、`保留原错: true`、`原错消息: 分页大小无效`、`冻结: true`。原生原因链指向同一个原始对象。错误实例已冻结，但不会冻结原因对象。

`new StorageContractError(code, details?, message?)` 创建错误后立即冻结。code 必填；details 默认 {}，字段 backend、key、cause 都可选，默认 undefined。backend 为 IBackendKind，key 为字符串或 IStorageKey，cause 是原始失败。message 省略时为 `[storage-contract] ${code}`。name 为 StorageContractError，source 恒为 `STORAGE_CONTRACT_SOURCE`，即 `'@migaia/storage-contract'`，不重写 stack，标准 cause 仍可追到原对象。
`isStorageContractError(value)` 使用本包类的 instanceof 判断。错误码属于公开 API；实现包自己的错误 source 与这里不同，使用 (source, code) 判断归属。web codec、迁移和扩展的附加诊断细节属于 storage-web，不扩进本包错误详情。

rows: 描述符、上下文、同步写或事务选项等非法；修正参数，不重试相同坏输入。
键类型、深度、节点、字节限制、循环、空数组或空洞非法；修正键。
所需能力不存在；先做能力分支或换实现，不静默降级。
已结束的实例继续使用；新建 store。
实现层操作被信号或超时取消；按取消处理，原子提交返回真实结果。

symbols.core:
invalidArgument: A public descriptor, context, synchronous write option or callback shape is invalid; correct the input before retrying.
invalidKey: A record key violates its type, finiteness, array, depth, node or binary-size domain.
unsupported: The supplied backend lacks the required capability or callable methods; select a suitable implementation.
disposed: A caller uses a backend after its disposal; create or obtain a new store.
aborted: A signal or timeout cancels waiting; writes already in atomic commit report the actual commit outcome.
